item.title: ‘Iran Is Being Destroyed in Front of Our Eyes’: Tehran Is Gripped by Fear
item.summary: Fifteen residents of Tehran said in telephone interviews and text messages that the capital was weathering heavy bombardment Friday.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Friday
item.summary: An American fighter jet was shot down by Iran for the first time since the start of the war, leading to an urgent search-and-rescue operation for a missing crew member.

item.title: Ex-US Army Pilot Recalls Battle for Survival When Shot Down in Iraq
item.summary: Ronald Young Jr. was in the Army when his Apache Longbow copter went down during the U.S. invasion of Iraq.

item.title: Iran’s Defenses Have Been Struck, but They Can Still Fire Missiles and Drones
item.summary: Iran has sent waves of missiles and drones at Israel and Gulf states in recent weeks and shot down an American fighter jet on Friday.

item.title: What We Know About the F-15E Strike Eagle Shot Down by Iran
item.summary: An F-15E Strike Eagle was lost to enemy fire and an A-10 Warthog crashed in the Persian Gulf region on Friday, officials said. A rescue helicopter was also fired upon.

item.title: Iran Is Quickly Repairing Missile Bunkers, U.S. Intelligence Says
item.summary: Reports cast doubt on how close the United States is to destroying Iran’s missile capability, a key goal in the war.

item.title: The F-15E Strike Eagle: What to Know
item.summary: The U.S. military aircraft with a two-person crew was shot down in Iran on Friday.

item.title: Kuwait Blames Iran for Attack on Power and Desalination Plants
item.summary: In Kuwait, an Iranian attack on Friday damaged a power and water desalination plant, officials said. Both sides in the Iran war have ramped up strikes on civilian targets.

item.title: At War With Iran Again, Some Israelis Fear Conflict Is Becoming Routine
item.summary: A majority of Israelis support the war with Iran, but many doubt that it will solve Israel’s long-term security problems. Some also question their prime minister’s assurances and motives.

item.title: Trump’s Strait of Hormuz Problem
item.summary: Our White House reporter Zolan Kanno-Youngs parses some of President Trump’s conflicting messages about the war with Iran.
